newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends bourse up 0.9 pct before U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends bourse up 0.9 pct before U.S. data.

text.p: 1142 GMT - German shares close bourse trade firmly ahead before release of U.S. payroll data at 1330 GMT. Dealers say buying interest returned to the market after days of declines, fuelled by enthusiasm for export shares. Volumes relatively thin and focus on U.S. for direction.
* DAX index ends up 29.69 points at 3,244.93 points.
* June DTB DAX futures up 30 at 3,254.0.
* BASF well ahead on well-received 1996 earnings, positive outlook for current year.
* BMW up 4.6 percent, all car shares rise.
